owner_priority: Preserve cheap candidates, but prioritize a plausible larger score reduction when both are available; balance upside, success probability and remaining work. No minimum submission-gain gate.
allowed_work: Focused primary literature and public source inspection
Written equations, error and fully charged cost derivations
Small synthetic mathematical checks using generated inputs
Read existing source and sealed result metadata without challenge target arrays
One or two ranked candidate specifications, or a reason to nominate none
not_in_this_task: New full challenge candidate execution or fitting
Opening challenge targets or final blind data
cheap_candidate_policy: Record a cheap candidate without stopping the recurrence if a credible larger-gain thread is visible.
timing_method: Log explicit research intervals and deduct orientation/record/tool overhead; idle waits count as zero. Theory and literature overlap only when explicitly labeled, never double-counted. At least120 useful total and80 active theory required.
